component.name: TransactionTable
component.business_context: Display a paginated and sortable list of transactions with status indicators and drill-down capability

constraints: Columns: date, amount, status, merchant name, payment method
Pagination options: 25, 50, or 100 rows per page
Status values: pending, completed, failed, refunded
Each status displays a colored badge

missing_states: loading — initial data fetch and sort/page-change re-fetch
empty — no transactions match current filters or account has no transactions
error — failed to load transaction data from API
hover (row) — visual feedback when hovering a clickable row
focus-visible (row) — keyboard focus ring on interactive rows
active sort column — visual indicator for currently sorted column and direction (asc/desc)
sort hover — hover state on column header sort controls
disabled pagination controls — prev/next buttons when on first/last page
loading (pagination) — spinner while fetching next page after page/size change
accessibility_gaps: Sortable column headers must use aria-sort='ascending' | 'descending' | 'none' on <th> elements to announce sort state to screen readers

Clickable rows must have role='button' or be wrapped in an interactive element with keyboard activation (Enter/Space) — Card with interactive=true is not suitable for table rows; a custom approach with tabIndex=0 and onKeyDown is required
Each row's click target must have an aria-label describing the action, e.g. aria-label='View details for transaction from {merchant} on {date}'
Status Badge is purely visual — surrounding row or cell must include visually-hidden text so status is announced in context, e.g. 'Status: Failed'
Payment method icons (e.g. Visa, Mastercard) rendered via Icon must have aria-hidden=true if the card brand name is present as adjacent text, or aria-label='Visa' if icon-only
Amount column must convey currency — aria-label or visually-present currency code/symbol to avoid ambiguity for screen reader users
Pagination controls must announce current page and total pages via aria-label, e.g. aria-label='Go to next page, currently on page 2 of 8'
Rows-per-page Select must have an explicit label, e.g. label='Rows per page'
Table must have a <caption> or aria-label describing its content, e.g. aria-label='Transactions'
Loading state must set aria-busy=true on the table container and render Skeleton placeholders with aria-hidden=true
Error state message must use role='alert' to be announced immediately
Empty state message must be programmatically associated with the table region so screen readers do not announce an empty grid silently
responsive_gaps: Touch target for row click must be >= 44px tall on mobile — ensure row padding meets minimum
Pagination prev/next IconButtons must have a minimum 44x44px touch target on mobile
Horizontal scroll must be enabled on narrow viewports as the 5-column table will overflow — wrap table in an overflow-x: auto container
Column priority on small screens — consider hiding lower-priority columns (e.g. payment method) below a breakpoint or switching to a card-list layout
Sort controls in column headers may be too small on touch devices — ensure the full <th> header cell is the tap target, not just an icon
Rows-per-page Select must be usable on touch — verify the Select component's tap target is adequate on mobile
recommendations: Use Badge with variant='warning' for 'pending', variant='success' for 'completed', variant='danger' for 'failed', and variant='neutral' for 'refunded' status indicators
Use Skeleton with variant='rect' and appropriate width/height for each cell during the loading state, inside a container with aria-busy=true
Use Spinner with size='md' and label='Loading transactions' for pagination re-fetch loading overlay
Use IconButton with variant='ghost', size='md', aria-label='Next page' and aria-label='Previous page' for pagination prev/next controls

Use IconButton with variant='ghost', size='sm' and aria-label='Sort by {column} ascending/descending' for column header sort triggers, using Icon name='chevron-down' or 'chevron-right' to indicate direction
Use Select with label='Rows per page' and options=[{value:'25',label:'25'},{value:'50',label:'50'},{value:'100',label:'100'}] for the page-size control
Use Icon with name='visa', 'mastercard', or 'amex' and aria-hidden=true (when card brand text is present) for payment method column icons
Use Icon with name='alert' and aria-label='Sort error' or within an error Banner for the table error state
Use Icon with name='chevron-right' and aria-hidden=true as a row-level affordance to signal drill-down capability
Apply --color-brand-primary for active sort column header highlight and --color-focus-ring for focus-visible row outlines
Apply --color-neutral-100 as row hover background and --color-border-subtle for row dividers
Apply --font-size-sm and --font-weight-medium for column header labels, --font-size-sm and --font-weight-regular for cell content
Apply --spacing-3 or --spacing-4 for row padding to ensure adequate touch target height on mobile
